Title: Surface OTel effective configuration in operational diagnostics.
Description: Extend diagnostics visibility so operators can verify telemetry posture without inspecting code or raw config files. Include whether OTel is enabled, tracing/metrics/export toggles, endpoint/protocol, sampling percentage, and configured path exclusions. Acceptance criteria: diagnostics snapshots include redacted effective telemetry configuration details, health/diagnostics workflows can confirm runtime telemetry posture, and no sensitive secrets are exposed.

Comments.Author: AgentSmith
Comments.Body: Operational diagnostics must expose effective telemetry posture without leaking secrets or payload data.
